d: Spiky, long charcoal-grey hair with wild, swept-up bangs and flowing locks that reach the lower back. Sharp, narrow golden-yellow eyes with a confident, smug expression on a face appearing to be in the late teens or early adulthood. A muscular, athletic build wearing a red and black cropped vest over a bare chest, paired with white trousers, a red waist-cloth, and red boots, all accented by numerous gold buckles and black straps. Signature details include a large red mechanical railgun resting on the shoulder and a small glowing orange orb floating above the left palm.
